UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Stores the authenticated user's primary CapitalFlow cloud workspace including active year, frequency mode, known years, global budget template, and savings/loans ledger.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner

knownYears.description: Bounded list of initialized budget years (max 20 years)

templateData.description: Native map storing the user's personalized Estimate Budget Template and custom categories

ledgerData.description: Native map storing the user's multi-year Savings Accounts, Transactions, and Loans ledger

lastDriveBackupAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp of the last optional Google Drive backup

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated

AnnualBudgetDoc.title: AnnualBudgetDoc
AnnualBudgetDoc.description: Stores a single year's budget entries, category budgets, templates, and period exclusions under a user's workspace.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the latest budget edit

entryMode.description: Entry mode for the annual budget

currency.description: Currency symbol for the annual budget

budgetPayload.description: Native map containing entries, budgets, customCategories, itemTemplates, excludedPeriodItems, isPersonalizedTemplate, and isDefaultStarterData

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the annual budget document was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the annual budget document was last updated

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Primary per-user CapitalFlow workspace document indexed by Firebase Auth UID

/workspaces/{userId}/budgets/{yearId}.description: Subcollection of annual budget documents belonging to the user's workspace
